text:
I need to filter transactions from 2024-05-25 to 2024-07-19 inclusive, calculate net amounts in USD for each customer (paid adds, refunded subtracts, pending ignored), and find the highest.

Let me work through this systematically:

**Transactions in date range (2024-05-25 to 2024-07-19 inclusive):**

| ID | Date | Customer | Amount | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| T1001 | 2024-05-27 | Cobalt | 4,209.73 EUR | pending | ❌ (ignored)
| T1011 | 2024-06-07 | Garnet | 812.34 EUR | paid |
| T1006 | 2024-06-11 | Fjord | 4,775.17 USD | paid |
| T1019 | 2024-06-30 | Cobalt | 2,423.29 EUR | paid |
| T1007 | 2024-07-10 | Birch | 2,731.34 USD | paid |
| T1009 | 2024-07-13 | Delta | 2,877.08 USD | pending | ❌ (ignored)
| T1003 | 2024-07-15 | Fjord | 3,335.13 USD | paid |

**Converting EUR to USD (at 1 EUR = 1.16 USD) and calculating net amounts:**

- **Garnet**: 812.34 EUR × 1.16 = $942.31
- **Fjord**: $4,775.17 + $3,335.13 = $8,110.30
- **Cobalt**: 2,423.29 EUR × 1.16 = $2,810.92
- **Birch**: $2,731.34

**Answer: Fjord** (highest net amount: $8,110.30)
